standard_prerequisites.name: Exactness of extension by zero and its construction
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stacks Project, Modules on Sites, Lemma lemma-extension-by-zero-exact (tag 09B4) and Lemma lemma-extension-by-zero (tag 09B5)
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides exactness of j_{U!} and the sectionwise description of the adjunction unit.

core_obligations: Reduce the statement to showing that j_{U!} reflects injections and surjections, since exactness of j_{U!} is already known (proof lines 2419-2423).

Prove that the adjunction unit G -> j_U^*j_{U!}G is injective, by unwinding the construction of extension by zero and identifying the unit with the sheafification of a sectionwise injective rule (proof lines 2425-2437 and following).
Use the unit and exactness of j_U^* to reflect surjections, and combine with the first part to conclude that j_{U!} reflects exactness of the displayed complex, completing the proof up to line 2458.
proof_roadmap: Use exactness of j_{U!} to reduce to reflecting injections and surjections.
Analyse the adjunction unit via the construction of extension by zero.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a complex of modules on an object U of a ringed site is exact exactly when its extension by zero along j_U is exact as a sequence of modules on the site. Since j_{U!} is already known to be exact, it suffices to prove that it reflects injections and surjections. This is done through the adjunction unit G -> j_U^*j_{U!}G: the unit is shown to be an injection by unwinding the construction of extension by zero as the sheafification of a sectionwise injective rule, and the reflection of surjections is obtained from the same unit together with exactness of j_U^* (proof lines 2419-2458). H2: the explicit description of the adjunction unit and its use to reflect both injections and surjections is the substance.
